children: Foreign investors' holdings of Italian government bonds rose in July, the country's central bank said on Friday.
The exposure of foreign investors increased by €7.4 billion  ($8.50 billion), a monthly report by the Bank of Italy showed.
In June, their holdings had significantly surged by €38.7 billion, the highest monthly increase since the 1990s.
